name_en: Sasa-zushi — vinegared rice on bamboo grass topped with mountain vegetables and salmon
summary_ja: クマ笹の葉に酢飯をのせ、山菜やサケ、野沢菜漬けなどを彩りよく盛りつける上越地方の押し寿司。上杉謙信の出陣にまつわる言い伝えがあり、お盆や祭りなどハレの日に振る舞われてきたと伝わる。
summary_en: A Joetsu-area sushi of vinegared rice set on bamboo grass leaves and topped colorfully with mountain vegetables, salmon and nozawana pickles. Legend ties it to Uesugi Kenshin's military campaigns, and it is said to have been served on festival and Obon occasions.
source_title: 笹寿司 新潟県｜うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Izushi — a nare-zushi of salmon, herring roe and vegetables fermented with rice and koji
summary_ja: 村上市に伝わる、サケや数の子、野菜を米と糀に漬け込んで発酵させたなれずし。特産の塩引きサケを使い、低温でじっくり発酵させる保存食で、正月の味として親しまれてきたと伝わる。
summary_en: A fermented nare-zushi from Murakami, salmon, herring roe and vegetables packed in rice and koji to ferment slowly at low temperature. Made with the region's signature salt-cured salmon, it is said to have long been treasured as a New Year delicacy.
source_title: 飯ずし 新潟県｜うちの郷土料理：農林水産省
